title: NYC Marathon: *61,146* finishers, a world record
hook: First marathon ever to see more than 60,000 runners cross the line.

slides.label: What happened
slides.c: The 2026 TCS New York City Marathon is the first marathon to pass 60,000 finishers. It is the third year in a row NYC set the record.

slides.label: The numbers
slides.c: The previous record was 59,830 at London in April. 15,745 finishers were international; 153 countries were represented.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.c: The record came on the 50th anniversary of the five-borough course. Figures are as of 1 Nov and may change after final scoring checks.

facts.claim: 61,146 finishers of 61,529 starters; first marathon above 60,000; previous record 59,830 London April 2026; third straight year
61,146 finishers, 15,745 international, 153 countries, 50 years of five-borough course, figures subject to final scoring

caption:
NEWS: NYC Marathon becomes first ever with 60,000+ finishers

The 2026 TCS New York City Marathon had 61,146 finishers (61,529 starters), beating London's 59,830 from April. Figures as of 1 Nov 2026, subject to final scoring.

Source: NBC Sports, Running USA
